panels.title: Service status
panels.description: Green = cAdvisor has seen the container in the last 60s. Red = it hasn't (stopped/crashed). Ignores the Service filter above.

panels.title: Restarts by service (1h delta)
panels.description: A rising line = the container is restarting. Click a series to focus it.

panels.title: OOM events by service
panels.description: The kernel OOM-killed a process in this container. Usually means its memory limit is too tight.

panels.title: CPU cores by service
panels.description: Per-second CPU cores by Coolify resource. Click a series to focus it.

panels.title: Memory vs limit (%)
panels.description: Only services that set a memory limit appear here.

panels.title: Container filesystem usage
panels.description: Writable layer disk usage per container (not host disk).

panels.title: Partner Apps  •  logs   (filtered by the Service dropdown)
Errors, warnings & exceptions  —  $resource
panels.description: error / warn / fatal / exception lines for the selected service(s).

panels.title: All logs  —  $resource
panels.description: Every line for the selected service(s), newest first. Pick a Service in the top bar to narrow it; use Explore for text search.

options.content: **Traces are wired but empty until the apps emit spans.** On each Coolify service set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://10.200.1.2:4318`, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=<name>`, `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp`. Flow: `app → Alloy(10.200.1.2) → OTel Collector(.52) → Jaeger`; RED metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`) are derived automatically. See [docs/dev-dashboards.md].

panels.title: Recent traces  ($service)
panels.description: Jaeger search. Choose $service once spans arrive.

panels.title: corporate network  •  latency between the fleet's boxes
Reachability (ICMP)
panels.description: Green = the box answered the last ping. Red = it didn't.

panels.title: Ping latency (RTT)
panels.description: Round-trip ping time between 10.200.2.52 (this stack) and every other box.

panels.title: HTTP request speed
panels.description: Time to fetch each box's node-exporter /metrics over the VPN - a stable, always-on synthetic request (not the app itself).
